thread:
Maria: Heads up — I'm seeing delayed PagerDuty notifications for prod alerts. I just missed an ack from prod-oncall; page was generated at 10:12 UTC but the oncall phone didn't ring until ~10:19. Anyone else?

incident-bot: :rotating_light: Incident created (INC-20260315-1) — possible notification delivery issue. Routed to #incidents and paged prod-oncall.

Jon: same here. Looking at our alert ingest -> PD delivery timeline, I'm seeing ~6-8m lag for a cluster of events starting 10:10-10:20 UTC. Not all alerts but a consistent batch.

Sam: checking https://status.pagerduty.com — nothing marked full outage but there's a note about 'notification queueing' in some regions. Can anyone pull PD webhook logs?

Kevin: grabbing webhook logs now. Seeing lots of 5xx responses from PD edge around 10:14-10:21. Example from our retry proxy: 
```
[2026-03-15T10:15:07Z] POST /v2/enqueue -> 503 Service Unavailable
request_id=abc123 latency=260ms
[2026-03-15T10:16:02Z] POST /v2/enqueue -> 202 Accepted (after 3 retries)
```
So PD is responding but with intermittent 5xx that cause our queueing/backoff to kick in.

Maria: thanks. I'm going to flip critical alerts to the backup routing policy so P0s still get paged. This will route to the SMS gateway and a secondary PD service.

Kevin: running route override now: 
```bash
redwoodctl pd route set --policy critical --fallback backup-notify --reason "pd edge queueing 2026-03-15"
```
Done. Confirming rollout.

incident-bot: Route override applied for policy=critical by Kevin. Notifying backup notification group.

oncall-scheduler: I manually acked two duplicate pages that arrived after delivery resumed to avoid unnecessary escalation.

Sam: also increasing local retry window and reducing exponential backoff for the next 30m to avoid long backoff tails. Config snippet: 
```yaml
pd_retry_policy:
  base_interval: 3s
  max_interval: 30s
  max_retries: 8
```
Applied to the notification proxy.

Maria: Customer impact summary for ops/CS: a subset of critical alerts experienced delayed delivery ~7-9 minutes; some users saw duplicates when PD recovered. Impact window ~10:10-10:22 UTC. We should update status page and notify major customers.

Jon: opened a ticket with PagerDuty (INC-987654) and sent logs. PD support replied: "We are seeing elevated queue times in our notifier cluster; engineers are investigating. We'll post updates."

PagerDuty Support: Thanks for the data. We've confirmed queueing on our edge cluster affecting some routed events. Engineering is working on mitigation. We'll update this thread with ETA.

Kevin: temporary mitigation also enabled: fanout critical pages to our SMS provider directly for 30m. Command used: 
```bash
echo "URGENT: P0 alert" | aws sns publish --topic-arn arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:123456:prod-sms
```
Traffic is now flowing through SMS and secondary PD service.

Maria: good work. Action items for post-incident:
- Kevin: make SMS fallback a documented and tested runbook (owner)
- Sam: add PD edge latency healthcheck & alert (owner)
- Jon: track PD ticket and escalate if no ETA within 30m (owner)
- Ops/CS: draft status page update and customer note (owner: Maria)

Sam: scheduling a synthetic paging test in 15m to verify both primary and fallback paths. Will post results here.

incident-bot: Severity lowered to Sev2 — mitigation in progress.

Maria: I'll draft the status page and the customer comms. Thanks everyone for the quick switches and manual acks. Keep monitoring PD status and our webhook metrics.

Jon: noted — I'll follow up with PD support and paste updates here.

Maria: closing loop for now. We'll reconvene for a short postmortem once PD publishes an RCA.
